issues.where: the walls of the lava channel in the foreground, centre to right
issues.what: the crust walls break into flat triangular facets with hard-edged polygon shadows and stretched, smeared texture; the bank reads as low-poly geometry, not rock (clear in set-A-06 right crop)
issues.fix: add displacement or subdivision to the channel banks, re-project the texture so it doesn't stretch on steep faces, and soften the shadow terminators

issues.where: the glowing cracks across the whole lava plain
issues.what: the cracks are thin, even-width neon lines that light nothing next to them; no warm bounce on the crust, no heat haze, and the same stroke width near and far
issues.fix: vary the crack width, add a falloff glow and emission bounce onto the crust beside each crack, and add some heat shimmer

issues.where: right crop, lava line and pools at x 83-100%, y 58-75%
issues.what: the glowing line breaks into a dashed gap, and the pool edges above it are stepped and pixelated like a thresholded mask
issues.fix: close the gap in the crack mask and anti-alias or blend the pool edges into the crust

issues.where: right crop, ground around the creature's foot
issues.what: the pahoehoe texture smears into horizontal streaks where it is stretched across the slope, and a smooth clay-like disc of ground surrounds the creature
issues.fix: fix the UV stretch on that patch and break up the moulded ring with real crust folds and cracks

issues.what: one swirly brush-stroke lava texture is used everywhere at the same scale, from the foreground to the far plain, so the land reads as a single material with no rubble, a'a or ash variation
issues.fix: mix in a'a, ash drifts, rubble and dull or glassy crust variation, and change texture scale with distance

issues.where: bottom-right crop, rocks and sulphur at x 0-17%, y 58-75%
issues.what: the rock texture is soft and smeared, and the yellow sulphur deposit shows a repeating fine pattern that looks like a tiled decal
issues.fix: raise the texture resolution on the near rock and replace the sulphur with crystalline crust, without a tiled pattern

issues.where: the stilt-legged creatures on the plain
issues.what: the feet barely touch the ground, contact shadows are faint or missing, and the bodies get no warm underlight from the lava they stand over; the poses are nearly identical
issues.fix: add contact shadows and ground deformation at the feet, add lava bounce light on the undersides, and vary the poses and gaits

issues.where: the creatures' feet in the middle distance and in set-A-07 at left
issues.what: the feet end in bright orange glowing tendrils that light nothing on the ground around them
issues.fix: let the foot glow cast light onto the crust, or reduce the emission

issues.what: the spatter reads as sharp separate dots with no motion blur or light on the fume
issues.fix: add motion blur to the spatter and let it light the surrounding smoke

issues.what: the steam is low-contrast and thin, with no light from the warm sky or lava in it
issues.fix: give the steam some warm rim light and more internal density variation
